methodology.promotion_rule: No signal reaches production without predeclared rules, implementation costs, regime tests, and out-of-sample evidence.

signals.name: Federal equity investment announcement effect
signals.hypothesis: New federal equity investment announcements may predict abnormal returns in recipients relative to comparable semiconductor companies.
signals.mechanism: Government capital, dilution, signaling and policy support can alter expected cash flows and risk premia.
signals.decay_mechanism: Announcements become anticipated or market participants arbitrage the effect.
signals.canonical_rule: Measure recipient return minus a predeclared peer basket after the first public announcement timestamp.
signals.notes: The exact event definition and eligible announcement universe must be finalized before backtesting.

signals.name: Public Apple call accuracy tracker
signals.hypothesis: The account's timestamped public Apple campaigns may contain directional or timing skill beyond chance and benchmark drift.
signals.horizon: post-specific; also 1, 5, 10, 20 and 60 trading-day standardized horizons
signals.mechanism: Potential discretionary insight into Apple positioning, valuation or market structure.
signals.decay_mechanism: Skill may be episodic, calls may become crowded, or public posting may lag actual execution.
signals.canonical_rule: Count one continuous thesis as one campaign; score all timestamped bullish and bearish campaigns using predeclared horizons and disclosed exits.
signals.notes: Scaled entries are not independent forecasts. Options P&L is unscorable without contract premium or a reproducible proxy.

signals.name: 90-period Hull moving-average regime filter
signals.hypothesis: A 90-period Hull moving average may improve trend participation or reduce adverse exposure in selected crypto markets and timeframes.
signals.mechanism: A smoother low-lag trend estimate may separate persistent direction from short-term noise.
signals.decay_mechanism: Crowding, timeframe overfitting and frequent reversals eliminate the edge after costs.
signals.canonical_rule: Test price-above/below and slope-change rules separately; never select the best-looking rule after viewing the test period.

signals.name: Bitcoin monthly VWAP reaction
signals.hypothesis: Bitcoin reacts predictably to monthly VWAP, potentially with stronger behavior near month-end.
signals.mechanism: Benchmark-aware positioning and inventory management may concentrate orders around monthly VWAP.
signals.decay_mechanism: The level becomes crowded or the visual relationship was selected retrospectively.
signals.canonical_rule: Predeclare touch, reclaim and exit definitions and compare month-end observations with all other sessions.

signals.name: Bitcoin as leveraged consumer-discretionary risk
signals.hypothesis: Consumer-discretionary risk appetite, represented by XLY or its constituents, may lead or explain Bitcoin returns in some liquidity regimes.
signals.mechanism: Both exposures may load on discretionary liquidity and long-duration risk appetite.
signals.decay_mechanism: The common factor changes or the measured relation is contemporaneous rather than predictive.
signals.canonical_rule: Test rolling beta and predeclared XLY-to-BTC lags against equity and liquidity controls.

signals.name: Korea/Japan semiconductor lead into SanDisk
signals.hypothesis: Late Korean and Japanese semiconductor moves predicted SanDisk's following U.S. session during a temporary June-July 2026 regime.
signals.mechanism: Memory-chip information and participant flow may transmit from Asian trading hours into SNDK with a lag.
signals.decay_mechanism: Institutional accumulation, participant exit, better liquidity or discovery of the trade closes the lag.
signals.canonical_rule: Use only foreign-market information known before an executable SNDK entry; score the campaign before and after the claimed regime break.

signals.name: Crypto leads U.S. equity rebound
signals.hypothesis: After a common macro risk dip, BTC, ETH, SOL and HYPE may progress through mechanically defined rebound stages before U.S. equity benchmarks and high-beta equity baskets.
signals.mechanism: Continuous crypto trading and faster risk re-entry may reveal improving liquidity appetite before U.S. equities fully recover.
signals.decay_mechanism: The relationship is only a trading-hours artifact or equities begin incorporating the same information immediately.
signals.canonical_rule: Using no more than 30 bars of recent realized volatility, compare the first timestamps at which each basket reaches local-low reversal, reference reclaim, trend confirmation and sustained recovery.
